work_order_manifest.description: Kontrollierte öffentliche Testphase öffnen, ohne den Produktionsstart freizugeben: DE/EN-Test-Landing, deutsches Testkonto und Passwort-Reset als eigene Test-Assets bereitstellen und die bestehende .maintenance-on-Sperre ausschließlich für diese Seiten, benötigte Styles, Rechtsseiten und feste Konto-Test-APIs durchlassen. .maintenance-on bleibt bestehen; platform_public_enabled, Publishing, Echtgeld, PayPal LIVE, Suchmaschinenindexierung und Produktionsfreigaben bleiben unverändert.

replacements.search:
# 1) HARD PRE-LAUNCH LOCK
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on -f
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/404\.html$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/acme-challenge/ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ - [R=404,L]
replacements.replace:
# 1) HARD PRE-LAUNCH LOCK + CONTROLLED PUBLIC TEST WINDOW
  # .maintenance-on stays in place. Only the dedicated public-test pages,
  # their required static resources, legal pages and account-test APIs pass.
  # All production publishing/payment gates remain server-side fail-closed.
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on -f
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/404\.html$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/\.well-known/acme-challenge/ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(?:|en/?|account/?|account/reset-password/?)$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(?:styles|home-redesign|developer-redesign|accessibility)\.css$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/assets/public-test-(?:home(?:-en)?\.html|account\.(?:html|js)|reset-password\.(?:html|js))$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(?:legal/(?:imprint|privacy|terms)|en/legal/(?:imprint|privacy|terms))/?$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/api/(?:public-config|country-check|player-signup|player-account|password-reset)/?$ [NC]
  RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(?:_gbd_public_config|_gbd_public_legal_gate|_gbd_proxy|_gbd_password_reset)\.php$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ - [R=404,L]

  # Dedicated public-test pages while the maintenance marker exists.
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on -f
  RewriteRule ^$ assets/public-test-home.html [L]
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on -f
  RewriteRule ^en/?$ assets/public-test-home-en.html [L]
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on -f
  RewriteRule ^account/?$ assets/public-test-account.html [L]
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on -f
  RewriteRule ^account/reset-password/?$ assets/public-test-reset-password.html [L]

replacements.search:
# 2) HTTPS + canonical host
  RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/.maintenance-on !-f
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on [OR]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^gamesbehinddoors\.de$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ https://gamesbehinddoors.de%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L,NE]
replacements.replace:
# 2) HTTPS + canonical host
  # Applies to allowed public-test routes as well; blocked pre-launch routes still 404 above.
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on [OR]
  RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !^gamesbehinddoors\.de$ [NC]
  RewriteRule ^ https://gamesbehinddoors.de%{REQUEST_URI} [R=301,L,NE]
